Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that concludes our coverage of the Women's T20 Commonwealth Games, 2022. Australia Women have finished on top and they win gold while India Women are the worthy silver medal holders. New Zealand Women finish third and win bronze after their win against England Women. All the three teams line-up to get their medals now. It is a proud moment for each of these teams and their country as a whole. Truly a moment to remember for the rest of their life! It has been a great pleasure and honour to bring to you the coverage of this competition. We will see you again as the cricketing action continues around the world. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Earlier in the game, Australia got to a good total with the bat courtesy of a fine knock by Mooney and cameos by Gardner and Haynes. Indians were brilliant in the field and did well to keep their hopes alive at the halfway mark. However, India just could not get the better of a strong Australian team and have to settle for a SILVER MEDAL in the Commonwealth Games, 2022.

Australia Women had some nervous moments in this game but they still had enough quality in them to get over all the hurdles that came their way. Megan Schutt got an important wicket of Rodrigues and then Ashleigh Gardner bowled a match-changing spell where she got the wickets of Kaur and Pooja Vastrakar. That brought them right on the top and then they brought their A-game on the field as they got three run outs and once again showed why they are the best.

India Women had a stiff target in front of them but they had the arsenal to chase down this total. However, the start was not good for India as both their swashbuckling openers departed in the Powerplay. However, Jemimah Rodrigues and the skipper Kaur were in no mood to let this game slip away so easily and they put together a fantastic stand of 96 runs. The wicket of Jemimah in the 15th over turned the game around as India started losing wickets at the regular intervals and have fallen short of the target in the end.

It’s a heartbreak for India Women though! They came so close again but just could not close out the game when it mattered the most but they will go back with a silver medal and should be proud of what they have achieved here. Talking about this match, it was a cracker of a game! A game that was worthy of a grand finale of a mega event. The momentum swung from one team to another and the game went right down to the wire but in the end, it is Australia Women who have held their composure in crunch situations and have beaten the Indian side in a big final again just like they did two years back in the final of the Women's T20 World Cup.

AUSTRALIA WOMEN WIN GOLD IN THE WOMEN’S T20 COMPETITION AT THE COMMONWEALTH GAMES, 2022! They have completed the trilogy that might never be achieved again - Women’s T20 World Cup, the 50-over Women’s World Cup and now the Gold Medal in the Commonwealth Games. This Australian team will surely go down in the history of the game as one of the best teams to ever play the game of cricket.

OUT! LBW! IT IS GOLD FOR AUSTRALIA WOMEN! Flatter and on middle. Yastika Bhatia tries to reverse hit it but misses and gets hit on the pads. That is dead in front but Bhatia wants to take it upstairs. No bat there. Ball Tracking shows it is the umpire's call on wickets hitting and the on-field decision stays. Australia Women win by 9 runs.

Yastika Bhatia has been given out LBW here! She has taken the DRS! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracking rolls and it is enough for Australia Women to continue with their celebration. It is all over for India Women!
Renuka Singh is the last batter in!

OUT! RUN OUT! This is full and outside off. Bhatia comes down the track and lofts it to long off. She tries to run back for two as Bhatia wants to keep the strike but the throw from Alana King is good enough to run out Meghna Singh at the bowler's end.
Flighted, very full and on middle. Bhatia skips down and eases it to long on. No run taken. Bhatia wants to keep the strike.
It will be Jess Jonassen to bowl the last over!

India Women get a crucial single! Yastika Bhatia retains the strike! Bhatia makes room and Megan Schutt follows her. It is fuller in length and Bhatia pushes it to covers and sets off for a single. The fielder there collects the ball and throws it a bit slowly and over Healy. She jumps and catches it. However, Meghna Singh makes her ground in the meanwhile. India Women need 11 from 6 balls!
On a length and following Bhatia on the leg side. Bhatia punches it back to the bowler. Dot ball.
A length and around off. Singh taps it to mid-wicket for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. 12 needed in 8 balls.
Meghna Singh walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! Deepti Sharma goes and it is all falling apart for India! A full ball, slower and it nips back in after landing around off. Sharma looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. A huge appeal for LBW and up goes the finger! Ultra Edge shows no bat. Ball Tracking shows three reds and Sharma goes now.

FOUR! Sharma needs to be the saviour for India now! On a length and on middle. Sharma skips down and thumps it over the bowler. The long on fielder runs across and dives but is of no use as the ball touches the ropes.
Yastika Bhatia is the new batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Australia Women are putting pressure on India. They have been excellent on the field! On a length and around off. Yadav makes room and punches it to mid off for a quick single. Grace Harris there, collects the ball quickly, throws and hits at the bowler's end. The replay shows Yadav was late and she has to make the long walk back.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off for another quick single. 17 needed in 12 balls.
Chance! Shorter and outside off. Sharma slaps it straight to covers where Megan Schutt dives to her left and almost took a blinder but fumbles to take it. Good chance there but was a hard one.
FOUR! Flatter and around off. Sharma looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a boundary.
Radha Yadav is the next batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! India lose another! This is short again on middle. Rana shuffles way across and pulls it straight to short fine leg. She goes for a quick single. Darcie Brown there throws it quickly to the bowler who collects it and whips the bails off.  The leg umpire takes it upstairs and Rana is well short of her crease. Rana actually just slipped while taking a run and that small margin has cost India a big wicket.
Is this a run out? Yes, it is! Sneh Rana is well short of her crease and she has to walk back.
FOUR! Sloppy fielding! Flatter and outside off. Rana punches it through covers. Tahlia McGrath from long off runs across and gets to the ball but fails to stop it cleanly. Four.
Too short but it doesn't bounce much off the deck. It is pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
Too full and on middle, pushed to covers for a single.
Short and outside off. Sharma pulls it flat to deep mid-wicket who collects on one bounce. A single taken.
On middle, swept to deep mid-wicket for one.
FIVE WIDES! Releases a bit of pressure! Shorter and way down the leg side. King tries to spin it back but doesn't and the keeper fails to collect it. It races behind to the fine leg fence.
Slides one full and on leg. Rana sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs. The umpire checks a short run and everything is fine as Rana had her bat in the crease.
Wide! Flatter and angling down the leg side. Rana misses her flick. A wide given.
On middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter and outside off, cut to point. A miscommunication but no harm done. 41 needed in 24 balls.
Sneh Rana walks out to the middle. She will be facing the hat-trick ball!

OUT! KAUR GOES NOW! The gold is slipping away from India! Ashleigh Gardner has turned things over as she gets the big fish now! What a game this is turning out to be! Flatter and on off. Kaur steps across and tries to scoop but mistimes and gets a faint edge onto her helmet. The ball lobs to the right of the keeper who runs across and takes it. Harmanpreet Kaur will be devastated as this was clearly not needed at this point.
Commentary.Howout: c Alyssa Healy b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Deepti Sharma walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Pooja Vastrakar goes without making much impact and Australia have two in quick time! Gardner continues to bowl short. This is on middle. Vastrakar comes down the track and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Beth Mooney there runs forward and dives to take a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and on leg. Kaur pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Serves short again on middle. Vastrakar pulls it down to long on for a single.
Drops it short and on middle, it is pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
Ashleigh Gardner is back on.
This is a slower delivery and around off. Tad short as well, Pooja Vastrakar slaps it straight to covers. India Women now need  44 from 30 balls!
On a length and angling into middle. Pooja Vastrakar works it to mid-wicket.
A fuller delivery on off. Pooja pushes it to covers.
Pooja Vastrakar comes to bat now.

OUT! BOWLED! Megan Schutt with a vital breakthrough for Australia Women! It brings to an end to a sensational partnership between the Indian number 3 and number 4. This is a leg-cutter from Megan Schutt on leg. Jemimah Rodrigues exposes all the stumps as she goes for the inside-out lofted drive. She misses and the ball knocks over the stumps. Big moment in the game!
A fuller delivery, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues squeezes it to deep point and comes back for the second run.
FOUR! Now, Jemimah Rodrigues joins the act! This is fuller on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues slog-sweeps it powerfully through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.

SIX! She started the over with a boundary and has finished it with a maximum now! 50 needed from 36 balls! This is tad shorter on middle. Kaur dances down the track and powers it over mid-wicket for a biggie.

A very full delivery on off. Jemimah Rodrigues digs it out to mid off and sets off for a quick single. The fielder at mid off fires a direct hit at the bowler's end as Jemimah Rodrigues dives to make her ground. The leg umpire takes it upstairs and the replays shows that Jemimah Rodrigues is saved by her dive.
King continues to bowl full lengh and it is on the pads. Kaur clips it through square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is around leg again. Kaur skips down the track again and clips it just short of the mid-wicket fielder. A single taken.
FOUR! Harmanpreet Kaur starts another over with a boundary! This is pitched around leg. However, Kaur shimmies down the track and makes room to slam it straight down the ground for a boundary.
On the pads and fuller. Kaur paddles it to fine leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to deep extra-cover for a single.
This is down the leg side and Kaur looks to paddle it. She misses and the keeper misses it too. The batters take a bye.
A fuller delivery on off. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it to covers for a single.

A fuller delivery on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it to mid off and looks for a single bu Kaur sends her back. Jemimah Rodrigues is halfway down but gets back into her crease and the replays confirm it. The fielder made a good throw at the batter's end but it was not enough.
A run out chance! Jemimah Rodrigues had to runs back to her crease as Harmanpreet Kaur is against the run. She is well in and not out it is.

Fifty for Harmanpreet Kaur! The Indian skipper is standing up when her team needs it the most. A low full toss on middle. Kaur works it calmly towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Can she take India to a historic win?
Goes fuller on middle and Kaur knocks it down to long on for a single. India Women now need 69 from 48 balls!
Bowls it close to off, it is on a length again. Jemimah Rodrigues guides it towards short third man for a single.
On a length, on middle. Kaur works it to mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! The Indian skipper is on the charge! On a length, on off. It is in the slot. Kaur looks to go big downtown. She does not get the middle of her blade but gets enough on it to hit it over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Bowls another full toss on the pads. This time Kaur does not miss out as she flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
A low full toss on middle. kaur whips it off her pads wide of long on. King does well in the deep as she runs to her right and stops it. Two taken.
On middle and fuller. Kaur skips down the track and heave it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Indian Women need 82 from 54 balls!
Tossed up, on off. Kaur drives it to mid off for a single.
King bowls it slower through the air, on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
This is tossed up on off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to mid off.
Goes fuller on middle. Kaur sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Perfect start for India to the over! Harmanpreet Kaur dances down the track to this delivery on middle and heaves it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Alana King is back on.
Another single as Kaur bunts it to square leg. The stand moves to 51 now. India Women need 89 runs in 60 balls.
Shorter and outside off. Rodrigues reaches to the pitch of the delivery and taps it to covers for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Kaur uses his feet and works it to square leg for one.
SIX! Just what India needed! A fuller ball on middle. Kaur comes down the track and lofts it to long on. Alana King was interested for a while but the ball went over the fence easily.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single. The required run rate is increasing.
An arm ball, full and on middle. Kaur sweeps it square on the leg side where the fielder collects on a bounce.

Breaking news - The Indian wicket-keeper Taniya Bhatia has been replaced by replaced by Yastika Bhatia as a concussion substitute. Taniya was hit on her head in the first innings and will not take further part in this game.
On a length, outside off, slower. Rodrigues dabs it to short third man. A fumble happens but Kaur is happy to stay against the single.
Shorter and outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle again. Kaur is happy to defend it.
Slower again, outside off. Kaur gets across and blocks it.
Slower length ball on off, Rodrigues wrists it to deep mid-wicket for one.
In the air and safe! On a length and on middle. Kaur gets on her knee to sweep but gets a top edge to fine leg for one.
Megan Schutt is back on. She went for 12 runs in her first over!
Keeps bowling it full. Rodrigues turns it to mid-wicket.
On a length and on off. Rodrigues steers it to short third man.
Good shot again! Too full and outside off. Rodrigues drives it through covers for a couple now.
FOUR! India are doing well to get boundaries! Again a full toss on middle. Rodrigues shows full face of the bat and drives it past mid off for four.
A full toss, around off. Kaur paddles it to square leg for one more.
FOUR! Fifty up for India! Just uses the pace here! This is on middle. Kaur gets inside the line and sweeps it fine to the fine leg fence.
Tahlia McGrath is into the attack now.
Slower and outside off. Rodrigues dabs it to short third man. Tidy start by King.
Fuller again, around off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Rodrigues drills it to long on for a single.
Slides it down the leg side. Kaur tickles it to short fine leg for a single.
On middle, quicker and might be the googly, tucked to square leg for a single.
Good fielding! Flatter and on leg. Rodrigues clears her front leg and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Ashleigh Gardner does well there to save a couple.
On a length, on off. Kaur defends it with soft hands towards the off side. India Women are 42/2 after the Powerplay!
FOUR! This time a glorious shot off the front foot! Brown overcompensates and bowls an half-volley, around off. Kaur leans forward and creams it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Now, Harmanpreet Kaur gets into the act! It is short on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur rocks back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Brown bowls it on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to mid on. King there fumbles and a single is taken. Good running!
FOUR! Nicely played by Jemimah Rodrigues! This is fuller on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues makes room again and square drives it uppishly and in the gap over cover-point for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Kaur works it to mid-wicket. The fielder there runs to her right and stops it. Just a single taken.
Goes fuller and on off. Jemimah Rodrigues makes a bit of room and drives it wide of mid off. The fielder there dives and half-stops it. Two runs taken.
Tossed up, angling on middle and leg. Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it to square leg. Straight to the fielder.
On middle, nudged to square leg for a single.
Fuller ball on middle. Kaur sweeps it to deep square leg and calls for two. Rushes back for the second and makes it.
Tossed up again slower now. Karu skips down and drags it to mid on.
Tossed up on off. Kaur sweeps it to square leg.
Jess Jonassen is into the attack now.
Bowls a short delivery on off. Jemimah Rodrigues ducks under it. Just a single from the over!
Back of a length, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues rides the bounce and pushes it towards point.
This is a low full toss again, around off. Kaur drives it to covers and takes a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Kaur drives it back to the bowler.
This is angling into middle. Kaur looks to clip it away but gets the inside edge onto her pads.
On a length, on off. Kaur punches it to point.
Angling into the pads. Jemimah Rodrigues works it to mid-wicket.
Goes fuller on off. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it towards the off side.
Harmanpreet Kaur walks out now.

OUT! CAUGHT! So the drop catch by Megan Schutt does not cost much to Australia Women! This is on middle. Verma dances down the track and looks to go big again. However, she gets a huge top edge again and the ball goes in the air towards mid on. Tahlia McGrath there settles under it and takes a fine catch. Both the Indian openers are back in the hut now.
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR BYES! This is bowled down the leg side. Shafali Verma moves across and looks to clip it but misses. The keeper misses it too and the ball races away for a boundary.
Angling into leg. Jemimah Rodrigues clips it to mid-wicket for a single.

Ohh... Megan Schutt drops a sitter! Shafali Verma dances down the track and Ashleigh Gardner pulls her length back slightly. Shafali Verma still goes with her slog. However, she gets a huge top edge and the ball goes in the air towards covers. Megan Schutt there moves a bit back and drops it after settling under it nicely. A single taken.
Goes fuller on off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to covers.
Jemimah Rodrigues is the next batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! Darcie Brown strikes! This is a huge wicket for Australia Women, the in-form Smriti Mandhana departs! Darcie Brown after bowling a wide delivery, outside off. Corrects her line and bowls it straight. It is on leg at 117.6 kph. Smriti Mandhana gets across and looks to flick it away but misses. The ball knocks over the leg pole and Australia Women get an important breakthrough.
Bowls it full and very wide outside off. Smriti Mandhana lets it go.
FOUR! Plays it with such grace and ease! This is an overpitched delivery, around off. Smriti Mandhana leans forward and creams it through covers for a boundary.
This is very full on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it with angled blade to cover-point again.
Goes fuller and around off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to cover-point.
Darcie Brown to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! This time an authorative shot from Shafali Verma! Back of a length and outside off. Shafali Verma shimmies down the track and punches it through the extra-cover region for a boundary. 12 runs from the first over!
Back of a length and around off. Smriti Mandhana steers it towards deep backward point for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Verma knocks it down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Finds the edge but it runs away for a boundary! Shafali Verma skips down the track and it is a length delivery on off. Verma tries to push it away. However, she gets the outside edge of her blade and the ball runs away towards the third man fence.
Smriti Mandhana also advances down the crease and powers it to sweeper cover for a single.
Megan Schutt starts off with a good-length delivery. It swings into Verma as she advances down the track and works it to mid-wicket for a single. Shafali Verma and India Women are underway!
